No exact standardized protocol emerged; matched ablation is a defensible synthesis. Freeze weights and disable dropout; within each user, mask equal numbers of recent versus old nonpadding interactions, retaining the identical final observed item, target, candidates, and original position IDs. Predefine eligible histories and mask sizes; include random-mask controls. Do not compact sequences, which shifts positions. Interior padding may itself be out of distribution: use a training-supported masking mechanism when available; otherwise report padding and replacement sensitivity separately. Equal mask counts cannot eliminate this confound. Interpret results as frozen-model perturbation sensitivity, not causal evidence of preference recency. [ROAR](https://papers.nips.cc/paper/2019/file/fe4b8556000d0f0cae99daa5c5c5a410-Paper.pdf) establishes the distribution-shift concern; its retraining protocol answers a different question.

For paired sampled HR@10, retain each user’s hit indicators under every condition, using the same pinned 99 negatives. Compute per-user differences; jointly bootstrap users within each category, then average the four category means equally. This adapts [paired bootstrap evaluation](https://aclanthology.org/W04-3250.pdf) and estimates user-sampling uncertainty conditional on the checkpoint and candidate draws. It does not estimate training-seed variation or full-catalog performance; sampled rankings can disagree with full-catalog rankings. [Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/).

With training seed fixed at 42, training-seed uncertainty remains unmeasured; user bootstraps cannot supply it. Independent retraining would require separately authorized, budgeted runs. [Benchmark variance research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03098) distinguishes these sources. Predeclare audit contrasts and selection rules, log all trials, and label validation intervals exploratory after adaptive selection: bootstrapping the winning checkpoint does not correct selection optimism. Leave final evaluation to the host’s untouched test procedure. [Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html).
